text: {"lessons":["My account is up overall, but monthly gains and losses are normal; I should focus on preserving savings for living expenses rather than chasing returns.","I have made few trades, and that patience has served me reasonably well; I should trade only when a clear change in risk or my needs justifies it.","Selling Stock A after a large gain reduced exposure, but gains alone are not a reason to sell; I should consider diversification and the risk of the whole account."]}
